description: Put a static site (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, fonts, WASM) on the web at https://<name>.ce-net.com/, free. Give the files with their text, or base64 for binary files; index.html is the front page. Up to 64 files. The first account to publish a name owns it; publish again to update. Pages run sandboxed: no forms, cookies or calls to other sites. Signed-in only, 3 sites per account.

base64.description: instead of content: the file's bytes in base64 (images, fonts, wasm)

content.description: the file's text (HTML, CSS, JS, SVG, JSON)

path.description: relative path, e.g. index.html or css/site.css

name.description: the site's name: 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or single hyphens; it becomes https://<name>.ce-net.com/

name: site_publish
title: Publish a static site, free
